1.explanation: The BreadcrumbSkeleton class and specifically its render() method generate anchor elements for each breadcrumb item that contain only a non-breaking space ( ) rather than meaningful link text or an image with alt text. This causes the DAP violation because hyperlinks must have accessible text or alt text for screen readers, so these skeleton links are not accessible and need to be updated to include an appropriate aria-label or hidden text.
1.bug_scenario: The Breadcrumb skeleton component renders three breadcrumb items using anchors with only a non-breaking space as their content. In the browser’s DAP panel, each link is flagged: “Hyperlink is missing link text or an image with alt text,” indicating an accessibility violation in the skeleton placeholder links.

2.explanation: The BreadcrumbSkeleton class in Breadcrumb.Skeleton.js is responsible for rendering the placeholder items. Its render method defines an anchor tag (<a href=“/#”>) containing only " ". Because this anchor has no visible text or aria-label, it fails the DAP rule requiring link text or an image with alt text. To resolve the violation, the render method (and thus BreadcrumbSkeleton) must be updated to include accessible text (for example via aria-label or a visually hidden label) on each placeholder link.
2.bug_scenario: In the BreadcrumbSkeleton component, each placeholder breadcrumb item renders as an anchor (<a>) containing only a non-breaking space. When running DAP IBM Accessibility checks, each link is flagged for missing link text or an image with alt text, causing a DAP violation.
